description: Indicates statistically significant decreased expression of a responding human gene following wild-type overexpression of the source gene, based on a consensus of LINCS L1000 expression signatures.

common_properties.name: z_score
common_properties.description: Signed Stouffer consensus z-score for the overexpressed gene and responding gene; negative values indicate decreased expression.

common_properties.name: p_value
common_properties.description: Bonferroni-corrected two-tailed normal p-value, corrected separately for each overexpressed gene and target tier; retained relationships pass significance at α = 0.05.

common_properties.name: tier
common_properties.description: Target gene evidence tier: landmark genes are directly measured; BING denotes well-inferred genes excluding landmarks.

common_properties.name: n_signatures
common_properties.description: Number of pooled expression signatures supporting the overexpressed gene’s consensus profile.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.notes: Single-element list under this source; list, never scalar

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the relationship was last created or updated.

source_contributions.scope: LINCS L1000 / Connectivity Map GEO series GSE92742 (Phase I) and GSE70138 (Phase II). Wild-type overexpression only; mutation and fusion constructs are excluded. Target genes are directly measured landmarks or well-inferred non-landmark BING genes; poorly inferred non-BING genes are excluded. Both endpoint genes must be present in SPOKE. No touchstone restriction is applied.
source_contributions.description: Signatures from both series and all wild-type constructs of the same gene are pooled across cell lines, doses, and times into one correlation-weighted Stouffer consensus. Negative consensus z-scores passing Bonferroni correction within each source gene and target tier produce these relationships. Significant landmark targets are uncapped; non-landmark BING targets are limited to the top 1,000 by significance per source gene. Self-relationships are retained and treated as autoregulation.
